note: Everyday writing tasks an agent gets asked to do. Each prompt gives the facts, so a good answer has no reason to invent filler.

prompts.prompt: Write a short Slack message to your team saying the release moves from Thursday to Monday because the payment provider's sandbox has been down since Tuesday. Two to four sentences.
Someone on a forum says their React app gets a CORS error calling their own Express API on another port, only in production. Write a reply that helps. Under 120 words.
A friend asks which note-taking app you use. You use plain markdown files in a git repo, synced with a cron job. Write your reply as a text message.
Write a support reply to a customer who was charged twice for one order (order 4471). The duplicate charge has been refunded today and should show in 3 to 5 business days. Under 100 words.
Write an email to a client moving Wednesday's 2pm review to Friday at 10am, because the staging environment needs one more day for their data import. Short.

Write a three-paragraph incident summary: on Nov 3 between 14:05 and 14:47 UTC, about 8% of checkout requests failed because a config change lowered the database connection pool from 50 to 5. It was rolled back. A check now blocks pool changes below 20.

Write a pull request description for a change that replaces polling every 5 seconds with a server-sent events stream for job status, cutting requests per active user from 720 an hour to 1 connection. Mention that the old endpoint stays for one release.
Write a docs paragraph explaining that the client caches GET responses for 60 seconds by default, how to change it with the cacheTtl option, and that POST requests are never cached.
Write a changelog entry for version 2.4.0: adds CSV export on the reports page, fixes timezone offsets in weekly summaries, drops Node 18 support.
Write a short launch post for social media: a bookkeeping app now reads receipts from photos and fills in the vendor, date and amount. It works offline and syncs later. Under 80 words.
Write the hero text (a headline and two sentences) for a website of a scheduling tool for dental clinics that sends patients SMS reminders and lets them confirm or reschedule by replying.
Write a LinkedIn post announcing that a 12-person logistics startup has hired its first data engineer, who will build the pipeline that predicts late deliveries. Under 120 words.
Write your standup update for Slack: yesterday you finished the invoice PDF export, today you're on the flaky login test, and you're blocked on staging access.
Someone on a forum committed a .env file with a database password to a public GitHub repo an hour ago. Write a reply telling them what to do. Under 120 words.
Write a message to a group chat of friends saying you can't make Saturday's hike because your car is in the shop until Monday, and asking if anyone can drive.
Write an email to a prospective client sending a quote: a booking website for their salon, 4 weeks, $6,500, with 50% upfront. Ask when they'd like to start. Short.
Write a polite email declining a vendor's proposal for a new CRM because the team is staying on their current system until next year's budget review.
Write a support reply to a user whose CSV export is missing the last row. It's a known bug, a fix ships Thursday, and in the meantime exporting to XLSX works. Under 90 words.
Write the opening paragraph of a README for a small CLI that converts SQLite databases to Parquet files, one file per table, with optional zstd compression.
Write a code review comment on a pull request that catches all exceptions in a payment webhook handler and returns 200, which hides failures. Suggest returning 500 so the provider retries.
Write a short migration note: the config key `timeoutSeconds` is renamed to `timeoutMs` in v3, values must be multiplied by 1000, and the old key is ignored with a warning.
Write the intro paragraph of a monthly customer newsletter for a project management tool: this month added Gantt view, recurring tasks, and fixed slow loading on large boards.
Write a product description for a stainless steel water bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours, holds 750 ml, and has a leak-proof lid. Under 70 words.
Write a short social post inviting people to a free online workshop on March 12 at 5pm GMT about setting up automated backups for small business websites.
Write a text message to a friend you haven't spoken to in a few months, just checking in. Two to four sentences.
Write a text to a friend saying you are running ten minutes late for dinner and asking what they want to drink.
Write a short message congratulating a former colleague on their new job.
Write a text inviting a few friends to a small get-together at your place on Saturday from 7pm.
Write a text to your neighbour asking whether they took in a parcel for you, since tracking says it was delivered.
Write a comment on a travel forum post where someone complained about a toddler crying next to them for a whole flight. One short paragraph.
Write a comment on a cooking Q&A site replying to someone whose bread keeps coming out dense. One short paragraph.
Write a comment on a cycling forum replying to someone asking whether a squeaky disc brake is dangerous. One short paragraph.
Write a comment on an advice forum replying to someone who thinks a friend is ignoring their messages. One short paragraph.
Write an answer on an advice forum for someone whose roommate keeps eating their food. About 150 words.
Write an answer on a parenting forum for a parent whose 8-year-old melts down when screen time ends. About 150 words.
Write an answer on an advice forum for someone who struggles to say no when friends ask for favours. About 150 words.
Write a group chat message suggesting a place for dinner on Friday and asking who is in.
Write a short thank-you text to a friend who helped you move flats last weekend.
Write an answer on a workplace advice site for someone who wants to ask for a raise after a year without one. About 180 words.
Write an answer on a workplace advice site for someone whose manager presented their work as his own. About 180 words.
Write an answer on a workplace advice site for someone who wants to quit two months into a new job. About 180 words.
Write an answer on a travel Q&A site for someone asking whether they can transit through a European airport without a visa. About 150 words.
Write an answer on a freelancing Q&A site for someone whose client is 60 days late paying an invoice. About 180 words.
Write a short email asking a colleague to cover your Friday afternoon support shift.
Write a press release from a city council announcing that three public libraries will open on Sundays from next month. About 200 words.
Write a press release from a transport department announcing a new night bus route between the airport and the city centre. About 200 words.
Write a press release from a government department announcing a grant scheme for small shops to install solar panels. About 200 words.
Write a press release from a health agency launching a campaign encouraging people to get their flu jab. About 200 words.
